get_conv_output_size: compute the output spatial size of a sparse convolution given kernel, stride, padding, and dilation parameters
get_deconv_output_size: compute the output spatial size of a sparse transposed convolution given kernel, stride, padding, and output padding
get_indice_pairs: build source-to-destination indice pairs for sparse convolution across 2D, 3D, or 4D sparse tensor grids
indice_conv: perform a sparse indice-based convolution on feature tensors using precomputed indice pairs and filter weights
indice_maxpool: perform sparse max pooling on feature tensors using precomputed indice pairs to aggregate neighborhood values
